scanNote:
KIRISH BETI (5-bet). Yuqorida katta to'q sariq sarlavha: 'Introduction'.

Matn IKKI USTUNGA bo'lingan, ular orasida vertikal chiziq.

CHAP USTUN:
• Enterprise 2 Elementary kursi haqida umumiy ta'rif (to'liq kurs, elementary daraja, productive va receptive ko'nikmalar).
• Kursning ko'p sillabusli yondashuvi (multi-syllabus approach) haqida.
• 'The course consists of fifteen units in four modules and a variety of supplementary material, including a workbook. In total, Enterprise 2 Elementary may be covered in 70-75 teaching hours.'
• Unit tuzilishi ro'yxati (nuqtali belgilar bilan): Lead-in sections, Reading sections, Language Development sections (ichida Vocabulary sections va Grammar sections), Reading and Listening sections.

O'NG USTUN:
• Reading and Listening bandining davomi.
• Pronunciation activities
• Communication sections
• Writing sections
• Revision Units (har to'rtinchi unitdan keyin)
• Three entertaining adventure stories ('comic strip' shaklida, ikki qismdan)
• 'The course is accompanied by:' a) Teacher's Book; b) Class cassettes yoki CDs va Student's cassettes yoki CDs; c) Enterprise 2 Elementary Workbook; d) Enterprise 2 Test Booklet (to'qqizta test, Mid-term test va Exit test).

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '5'.

⚠ Matnda 'Revision Units' deyilgan, mundarijada esa 'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT' - nomlar farq qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Introduction - Enterprise 2 Elementary is a complete course for students studying English at elementary level.
exercises.instructionUz: Kirish - Enterprise 2 Elementary boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tili o'rganuvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - KITOBGA KIRISh (5-bet).

  U ASOSAN O'QITUVChI UChUN yozilgan,
  lekin o'quvchi ham undan katta foyda
  oladi: kitob QANDAY tuzilganini va
  har bo'lim NIMA UChUN kerakligini
  bilgan odam tezroq o'rganadi.


KURSNING HAJMI:

  15 UNIT, 4 MODUL
  70-75 DARS SOATI

  ⚠ 'may be covered in 70-75 teaching
  hours' = 70-75 dars soatida
  o'tilishi mumkin.
  ⚠ 'to cover' bu yerda = o'tmoq,
  qamrab olmoq.


HAR UNITNING TUZILIShI:

  1) LEAD-IN
     = KIRISh, mavzuga olib kirish.
     O'quvchi biladigan narsadan
     boshlanadi, yangi lug'at va
     grammatika oldindan ko'rsatiladi.
     Oxirida TINGLASh mashqi.

     ⚠ 'to lead in' = ichkariga
     boshlab kirmoq.

  2) READING
     = O'QISh. 200-350 so'zli matnlar.

     ⚠ Sub-skills (kichik ko'nikmalar):
        'reading for gist' = umumiy
           mazmunni tushunish uchun o'qish
        'reading for specific information'
           = aniq ma'lumot izlab o'qish

  3) LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT
     = TIL RIVOJI. Ikki qismdan:

        VOCABULARY - lug'at.
        ⚠ Ayniqsa COLLOCATIONS -
        so'zlarning doimiy birikmalari
        (masalan 'make a mistake', lekin
        'do homework'). Ularni ALOHIDA
        emas, BIRGA yodlash kerak.

        GRAMMAR - grammatika.

  4) READING AND LISTENING
     = o'qish va tinglash birga.

  5) PRONUNCIATION
     = TALAFFUZ. Hamma talaffuz
     mashqlari kassetada.

  6) COMMUNICATION
     = MULOQOT. Haqiqiy hayotdagi
     vaziyatlar: qabul qilish, rad etish,
     narx so'rash, odamlarni kutib olish.

     ⚠ 'sociolinguistic features' =
     tilning ijtimoiy tomoni: kimga
     QANDAY gapirish kerak (do'stga
     boshqacha, rasmiy odamga boshqacha).

  7) WRITING
     = YOZISh. Xatlar, tavsiflar,
     hikoyalar, maqolalar.

  8) REVISION UNITS
     = TAKRORLASh. Har TO'RTINChI
     unitdan keyin.

     ⚠ MUHIM NOMUVOFIQLIK: kirishda
     'Revision Units' deyilgan, lekin
     mundarijada va kitob ichida ular
     'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT' deb
     nomlangan.

  9) THREE ADVENTURE STORIES
     = uchta sarguzasht hikoya,
     'comic strip' (komiks) shaklida,
     har biri ikki qismdan.

     ⚠ 'entertaining' = qiziqarli,
     ko'ngil ochadigan.
     ⚠ 'an adventure' = sarguzasht.


KURS BILAN NIMA KELADI:

  a) Teacher's Book
     = o'qituvchi kitobi (to'liq javoblar
       va testlar bilan)

  b) Class cassettes / CDs va
     Student's cassettes / CDs
     = sinf va o'quvchi uchun yozuvlar

  c) Enterprise 2 Elementary Workbook
     = mashq daftari

  d) Enterprise 2 Test Booklet
     = testlar to'plami: 9 ta test,
       Mid-term test (o'rta muddat testi)
       va Exit test (yakuniy test)

  ⚠ 'to accompany' = hamrohlik qilmoq
     → 'accompanied by' = ... bilan birga
     keladi.


⚠ IKKI MUHIM ATAMA:

  RECEPTIVE SKILLS (qabul qiluvchi):
     reading, listening

  PRODUCTIVE SKILLS (faol):
     speaking, writing

  ⚠ Kirishning birinchi jumlasida
  aynan shu ikki so'z ishlatilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an introduction = kirish
  a course        = kurs
  complete        = to'liq
  extensive       = keng, mo'l
  systematic      = tizimli
  productive      = faol, hosil qiluvchi
  receptive       = qabul qiluvchi
  a syllabus      = o'quv dasturi
  an approach     = yondashuv
  graded          = darajalangan
  to acquire      = egallamoq
  acquisition     = egallash
  a lead-in       = kirish qismi
  gist            = umumiy mazmun
  a sub-skill     = kichik ko'nikma
  a collocation   = so'z birikmasi
  to consolidate  = mustahkamlamoq
  revision        = takrorlash
  entertaining    = qiziqarli
  an adventure    = sarguzasht
  a comic strip   = komiks
  to accompany    = hamrohlik qilmoq
  a booklet       = kitobcha
  to assess       = baholamoq

points.en: Enterprise 2 Elementary is a complete course for students studying English at elementary level.
points.uz: Enterprise 2 Elementary - boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tili o'rganuvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'complete' = to'liq, tugal.
⚠ 'studying' - PRESENT PARTICIPLE:
'students studying English' = ingliz tilini
o'rganayotgan o'quvchilar.

points.en: It provides them with extensive, systematic and well-integrated practice in the productive and receptive skills.
points.uz: U faol va qabul qiluvchi ko'nikmalar bo'yicha keng, tizimli va yaxshi uyg'unlashgan mashq beradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PRODUCTIVE = speaking, writing
⚠ RECEPTIVE = reading, listening

⚠ 'to provide sb WITH sth' = kimnidir nimadir
bilan ta'minlamoq. Predlog 'with'.

points.en: The course consists of fifteen units in four modules.
points.uz: Kurs to'rt moduldagi o'n beshta unitdan iborat.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' = ... dan iborat bo'lmoq.
Predlog 'of' - HAR DOIM.

⚠ Bu fe'l CONTINUOUS shaklda ishlatilmaydi:
'is consisting' - XATO.

points.en: In total, Enterprise 2 Elementary may be covered in 70-75 teaching hours.
points.uz: Jami Enterprise 2 Elementary 70-75 dars soatida o'tilishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'in total' = jami.
⚠ 'to cover' bu yerda = o'tmoq, qamrab olmoq
(odatdagi 'yopmoq' ma'nosida emas).

points.en: Lead-in sections draw on the students' knowledge of the given topic.
points.uz: Lead-in bo'limlari o'quvchining mavzu bo'yicha mavjud bilimiga tayanadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to draw on sth' = nimadandir foydalanmoq,
unga tayanmoq.

⚠ Ya'ni dars YANGI narsadan emas, o'quvchi
BILADIGAN narsadan boshlanadi.

points.en: Reading sections consist of 200- to 350-word texts on factual topics.
points.uz: O'qish bo'limlari haqiqiy mavzulardagi 200-350 so'zli matnlardan iborat.
points.noteUz:
⚠ '200-word text' - son bilan ot birga sifat
bo'lganda ot BIRLIKDA qoladi va DEFIS qo'yiladi:
'a 200-word text', 'a five-year-old boy'.

points.en: A particular feature of the book is the teaching of collocations.
points.uz: Kitobning alohida xususiyati - so'z birikmalarini o'rgatish.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a collocation' = doimiy so'z birikmasi.

⚠ Masalan: 'make a mistake' (do emas),
'do homework' (make emas).

⚠ Ularni ALOHIDA emas, BIRGA yodlash kerak -
bu ilovaning ham asosiy g'oyasi.

points.en: Pronunciation activities help students to recognise sounds and reproduce them correctly.
points.uz: Talaffuz mashqlari tovushlarni tanib olishga va to'g'ri takrorlashga yordam beradi.

points.en: Communication sections ... include language functions (i.e. accepting, refusing etc.).
points.uz: Muloqot bo'limlari til vazifalarini (qabul qilish, rad etish va h.k.) o'z ichiga oladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'i.e.' = 'id est' (lotincha) = ya'ni.
⚠ 'etc.' = 'et cetera' = va hokazo.

⚠ 'to accept' = qabul qilmoq
⚠ 'to refuse' = rad etmoq

points.en: Revision Units after every fourth unit reinforce the students' understanding.
points.uz: Har to'rtinchi unitdan keyingi takrorlash bo'limlari tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ NOMUVOFIQLIK: kirishda 'Revision Units',
mundarijada esa 'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT'.
Bir narsaning ikki nomi.

⚠ 'to reinforce' = mustahkamlamoq.

points.en: Three entertaining adventure stories in a 'comic strip' format, presented in two episodes each.
points.uz: Uchta qiziqarli sarguzasht hikoya komiks shaklida, har biri ikki qismda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'entertaining' = qiziqarli.
⚠ 'an adventure' = sarguzasht.
⚠ 'a comic strip' = komiks (rasmli hikoya).

⚠ DIQQAT: mundarijada uchinchi hikoya
('On the Top of the World') QISMLARGA
bo'linmagan - u 4 betlik yaxlit hikoya.

points.en: The course is accompanied by: a) Teacher's Book; b) Class cassettes or CDs; c) Workbook; d) Test Booklet.
points.uz: Kurs bilan birga: a) O'qituvchi kitobi; b) Sinf kassetalari yoki CD; c) Mashq daftari; d) Testlar to'plami.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to accompany' = hamrohlik qilmoq
→ 'is accompanied by' - MAJHUL NISBAT.

⚠ Test Booklet'da 9 ta test, Mid-term test
(o'rta muddat) va Exit test (yakuniy) bor.

patterns.exampleEn: The course consists of fifteen units.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' — predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: It provides students with extensive practice.
patterns.exampleUz: U o'quvchilarni keng mashq bilan ta'minlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to provide sb WITH sth' — predlog 'with'.
⚠ Yoki: 'to provide sth FOR sb'.

patterns.exampleEn: The course is accompanied by a workbook.
patterns.exampleUz: Kurs bilan birga mashq daftari keladi.
